column3: NASB renders “saying” as “statement,” “overseership” as “the office of overseer,” and “a good work” as “a fine work.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text without “greedy of base gain”; “striker” is rendered “pugnacious,” and “peaceable” is “uncontentious.”
NASB adds “He must be one who” and renders “having children in submission” as “keeping his children under control.”
NASB puts the verse in parentheses.
NASB renders “novice” as “new convert” and “the judgment of the devil” as “the condemnation incurred by the devil.”
NASB follows the critical text without “him”; it adds “the church” and renders “testimony” as “reputation.”
NASB adds “men of” and renders “greedy of dishonest gain” as “fond of sordid gain.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “slanderers” as “malicious gossips” and “clear-minded” as “temperate.”
NASB adds “as deacons” and renders “a good standing” as “a high standing.”
NASB follows the critical text (“before long”).
NASB adds “I write” and renders “base” as “support.”
NASB follows the critical text (“He who”); the Textus Receptus reads “God.” “Confessedly” is rendered “by common confession,” and “was justified” is “was vindicated.”
